text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week doesn't seem to be feeling
well...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Actually, my head kind of hurts... I
wonder why...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because I woke up and went
back to
sleep twice after having dreams
about eating
tasty foods...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe it's because I shared a whole
lot of ice
cream with El and the others
and ate too much...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer... I dunno what the cause
is. There
are just way too many
possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week laments over her
headache...
